verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs describe an Elements system that keeps character identity and voice persistent across multiple shots and scenes in 3.0 Omni. They also describe multi-shot storyboarding of up to 6 cuts, which addresses cross-shot consistency rather than single-clip coherence. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Elements is set up and its limits (e.g., scene/environment consistency beyond characters, number of elements), independent or hands-on corroboration that identity actually holds across separate generations.

support.subject: As a creator, a character or scene stays consistent across multiple generated shots, not just within one clip

citations.quote: Elements system for persistent character identity and voice across multiple shots and scenes (3.0 Omni)
Multi-shot storyboarding with per-shot camera control (pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, handheld) up to 6 cuts
Supports multiple ways to generate image series, with coherent storytelling and a consistent visual style.
